question: Which of the following is NOT used for storage in computer systems?
solution:
The correct answer __**Adder**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An adder is a digital circuit that performs the addition of numbers.
 
• It is a processing unit, not a storage unit.
 
• It's a fundamental building block in computer systems, particularly within the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) of a processor.
